# Aimbot

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** Aimbot, AimBot

## What it does

Aimbot quietly turns your view toward nearby players and mobs so your crosshair tracks them for you. It only aims — it does not click or attack — so it pairs well with a manual playstyle or with modules that handle the clicking, like AutoClicker or KillAura .

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/combat/aimbot). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
